method: Read actual contracts and assertions, match exact passed remote-only tests, verify current text equals clean tested commit after CRLF normalization with both raw hashes retained, check canonical requirement text hash

tests: registration uniqueness, observable publication and idempotent cleanup survive replacement
built plugin and optional consumer clean up and reactivate through real Cordis and official SlotRegistry
registry.proof: Registration returns idempotent cleanup, rejects duplicate identities and publishes stable metadata. Actual Cordis/SlotRegistry disposal removes application, overlay and sidebar entries; reload has one entry and no Session acquisition.

tests: built optional adapter shares the owner and cleans scopes across absent, unsupported, unload and reload with real Cordis
sidebar.proof: Built optional adapter uses the same Workbench owner; repeated opening preserves one window, page and geometry. Disposal balances descriptors/listeners and ignores stale callbacks. Unsupported version/features show sidebarUnsupported while primary workspace still opens.

tests: durable drafts, isolated preview, CAS activation and invalid replacement preserve running version
only owned installed data sources activate and withdrawing a plugin preserves running recipe
Host route rejects unauthenticated, oversized, unsupported schema and embedded data/code
recipe.proof: Actual DomainFacility/JSON Host rejects code/data in scalar recipes. Save/preview do not publish; activation uses CAS; invalid module, role or connection cannot replace running version. Installed archive receipt separately proves authenticated lifecycle and cold restart.

tests: real Host persists availability, rejects stale writes, and restore never touches app data or Sessions
before Host readiness opens are gated and disabled apps remain gated after refresh
application availability disables entry without deleting mounted draft or role owner
availability.proof: Actual Host stores only enable state and revisions; Client gates opens before readiness and while disabled. Mounted draft/role owner remains. Archive lifecycle and Reading reinstall preserve exact own data and running version.

rows.status: satisfied at shared catalog/state contract; full teaching workflow in all sidebar environments remains a separate gate
satisfied: public declaration and supported slot registration, exercised by optional consumer and installed Kaogong/Reading
satisfied: built-plugin dispose/reactivate through actual Cordis/SlotRegistry removes old registration and avoids duplicate entries
satisfied for optional Better Sidebar incompatibility: explicit unsupported reason and working primary entry; no broad version support claim
satisfied: stable registration fields, duplicate rejection, cleanup and zero Session acquisition
satisfied: persisted state contains stable preferences, not installed definitions or React content
satisfied: absent provider has no registration; unsupported provider keeps primary entry; real Cordis disposal tested
satisfied: catalog delegates to the same owner and never borrows Sidebar Session state
satisfied: explicit activation is the only publication step; generated/saved/previewed drafts retain running version
satisfied: disabled and readiness-pending applications cannot open, including after preference reload
partial: explicit Host module/role/connection failures preserve old running version; capability-specific rendered recovery remains separately indexed
satisfied for scalar recipe contract: stable declared identities and no executable/business data payload; credential handling audit remains separate
satisfied for first-release owned-data connection contract; real external cross-app authorization remains out of scope
satisfied: distinct draft/preview/running state, validated references, CAS, failure retains old running version
satisfied: disabling changes availability only; exact Reading data and running recipe survive restore and reinstall

limits: These contract-level requirements do not certify the broader native UI, model, physical IME or three-environment teaching gates
Actual archived install uses existing public development dependency anchors
No new code changes or test suite rerun; tests are the observed 288/288 exact remote implementation run
